issues.display_title: Issue #1933: Provide Detailed Destination Storage Error on Transfer Tour Failure
issues.main_description_html:
Description

Provide detailed and professional destination storage error reporting on POST /v2/tours/transfer-overlay when the recipient account lacks sufficient storage, replacing the generic Storage is full. error.

Requirements

  1. Storage Calculation: Compute target user's available space (available_space in GB) and required tour space (required_space in GB).
  2. Detailed Message: Include destination email, available space, and required space in the error message.
  3. Localization: Add messages.tours.transfer_storage_full across all 18 dashboard languages.
  4. Response Contract (409 Conflict):
{
  "statusCode": 409,
  "data": {
    "messages": "Insufficient storage on the destination account. User target@example.com currently has 0.5 GB available, but this transfer requires at least 1.2 GB. Please ensure the recipient has sufficient storage before retrying.",
    "reason": "storage_full",
    "details": {
      "user": "target@example.com",
      "available_space": 0.5,
      "required_space": 1.2
    }
  }
}

Result

  • BE PR: #1932 (merged)
  • FE PR: GoThruMedia/gothru-dashboard#4319 (merged)
  • Tests: BatchTransferToursOverlayActionTest, BatchTransferToursOverlayControllerTest

issues.display_title: Issue #1936: Implement PayPal Subscription Webhook Ingestion & Status Check API
issues.main_description_html:
Objective

Implement a server-to-server PayPal Webhook listener as the sole authority for subscription payment ingestion into cc_purchase, cc_logs_paypal, user tier activation, and invoice generation, resolving payment loss caused by browser capture disconnects (closes #1934).

Implementation Requirements

1. Metadata Binding (custom_id)

  • In app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Paypal/Subscription/Subscription/CreateSubscription.php:
    • Attach custom_id = "user_id:{userId}|plan:{plan}|action:{action}" to the subscription creation payload sent to PayPal REST API.
    • Ensures webhook events carry deterministic user and plan context without depending on client-side state.

2. Signature Verification

  • In app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Helpers/Paypal/PaypalWebhookHelper.php:
    • Call PayPal official API POST /v1/notifications/verify-webhook-signature to validate:
      • auth_algo
      • cert_url
      • transmission_id
      • transmission_sig
      • transmission_time
      • webhook_id
    • Reject invalid signatures with HTTP 400.

3. Webhook Listener & Routing

  • Route: POST /paypal/webhooks (public, no auth middleware).
  • Controller: app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Paypal/PaypalWebhookController.php.
  • Event Handlers in app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Paypal/Webhook/:
    • PAYMENT.SALE.COMPLETED:
      • Idempotency: verify transaction not already in cc_purchase.
      • First Payment: Insert cc_purchase (note = "First Payment for: {user_id}"), insert 2 entries in cc_logs (S and R), update user tier, call handleAffiliation(), and generate invoice PDF.
      • Recurring Renewal: Insert cc_purchase (note = "Recurring Payment for: {user_id} ({sub_id})"), insert cc_logs_paypal, update expiry, send invoice email.
      • Cache status in Redis: paypal:sub_status:{subscriptionId} {"status": "active", ...} (TTL 1h).
    • PAYMENT.SALE.DENIED & failures:
      • Log failure to cc_logs_paypal with result: 1.
      • Cache failure reason in Redis: {"status": "failed", "error_code": "DENIED", ...}.
    • BILLING.SUBSCRIPTION.ACTIVATED / CANCELLED:
      • Sync user_extra_data.recurring_profile and unsubscribes table.

4. Real-time Status Check Endpoint

  • Route: GET /paypal/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/status (with auth middleware).
  • Handler: app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Paypal/Subscription/Subscription/GetSubscriptionStatus.php.
  • Fast response (<5ms) reading from Redis with DB fallback.

5. Rollout Guard

  • Guard webhook processing to test mode / test users (isUseStripeTestMode) during rollout.

Linked Pull Request

  • PR: #1935

Result

  • PR Status: Merged into main via PR #1935.
  • Implemented Components:
    1. CreateSubscription.php: Bound metadata custom_id containing user_id, plan, and action.
    2. PaypalWebhookHelper.php: Cryptographic signature verification via PayPal API /v1/notifications/verify-webhook-signature.
    3. PaypalWebhookController.php: Automatic Sandbox vs Live environment detection from paypal-cert-url header.
    4. PaymentSaleCompletedHandler.php: Deterministic First Payment vs Recurring Renewal separation, idempotency check on cc_purchase.transid, user tier update, affiliation trigger, invoice PDF generation, and Redis status caching (paypal:sub_status:{id}).
    5. PaymentSaleDeniedHandler.php: Catches payment failures, logs to cc_logs_paypal, and sets status = failed in Redis with specific PayPal error reason.
    6. SubscriptionActivatedHandler.php & SubscriptionCancelledHandler.php: Automatic subscription profile synchronization.
    7. GetSubscriptionStatus.php: Real-time status polling endpoint (GET /paypal/subscriptions/{id}/status) responding in <5ms from Redis cache with DB fallback.
    8. routes/paypalRoutes.php: Registered public POST /paypal/webhooks and authenticated GET /paypal/subscriptions/{id}/status.
  • Testing & Verification:
    • PaypalWebhookTest.php: 8/8 tests passing (100%).
    • Full PayPal controller test suite (tests/Http/Controllers/Payment/Paypal/): 48/48 tests passing (100%).
    • Live PayPal Sandbox webhook listener registered and active (01957627G25543502) pointing to https://apil.gothru.co/paypal/webhooks.
